name: place-on-player
description: A building cannot be placed with the player inside its footprint; the ghost shows it, a click does nothing, and the player can still walk. Placing right next to the player works.

steps.comment: The player stands in cell (32, 32); a Smelter aimed there covers it.
Cell (35, 32) puts the 3x3 Smelter at anchor (34, 31), just clear of the player.
The player walked away (screen-left is world -X, +Z).
